scope: B2-F EpochHandoffProof fields 1..11 composition kernel only

aggregate_cev0.rule: The protobuf message is a transport composition only. Every nested CEV0 value is parsed and hashed under its own frozen domain; no aggregate byte string is signed, hashed, or accepted as authority.

composition.name: EpochHandoffProofCompositionKernelV0
composition.inert_result: JointHandoffKernelV0 bound-facts token only; it cannot construct an EpochAnchorQC or authorize a transition
verification_order: parse and re-encode old/new consensus parameters and recompute each parameters digest
parse and re-encode old/new validator sets and recompute each validator-set digest
parse and re-encode the next-epoch commitment and recompute its commitment digest
parse and independently verify the complete old checkpoint/two-seal finality proof including proposer and QC Ed25519 signatures
bind the finalized checkpoint and both seals to the exact commitment digest
bind the commitment to the exact new validator-set and parameter preimages
bind the handoff descriptor to the exact checkpoint, terminal seal, terminal certifying-QC digest, contexts, commitment, and activation geometry
parse and verify canonical old-role and new-role signer lists independently under the handoff-vote domain
recompute each weighted quorum from its exact committed set
return a fields-1..11 composition token with no aggregate digest
relations: schema_version equals 0 across every nested v0 CEV0 value
genesis_hash and chain_id are byte-identical across the transport context and every nested value
old_checkpoint_finality is exactly checkpoint <- epoch_seal_1 <- epoch_seal_2 under the old set and old parameters
the checkpoint and both seals carry the same exact next_epoch_commitment digest
next_epoch_commitment.old_epoch equals the old set/finality epoch and new_epoch equals old_epoch + 1
new_validator_set epoch/version/parameters hash and commitment rollout redundancy match the new context
handoff_descriptor checkpoint fields equal the finalized checkpoint header
handoff_descriptor terminal fields equal the exact seal_2 header and its exact certifying-QC digest; another valid signer subset is not substitutable
handoff_descriptor set, parameter, version, epoch, commitment, activation, and initial-view fields equal the supplied preimages
old and new handoff roots use message kinds 3 and 4 respectively and cannot substitute for one another
old and new signer lists are separately ordered, unique, members of their role set, strictly Ed25519-valid, and each reaches floor(2W/3)+1
without field 12, new_protocol_version must equal the old protocol version and upgrade_plan_hash must be absent

positive_profiles.rule: The new ordered validator identities and keys differ from the old set; both exact set digest and independent new-role quorum are verified.

fallback_used is true with reason 1..9; the new set is the old ordered identity/key/power tuple re-encoded only for new_epoch, parameters are byte-identical, rollout is unchanged, and no upgrade hash is present.

rejection_classes.rule: Reject a non-checkpoint first header, broken seal geometry, wrong frozen roots/state, or invalid checkpoint-finality signature.
Reject any terminal height/view/block/QC field not equal to the exact seal_2 witness.
Reject any checkpoint/seal, descriptor, set, parameter, rollout, fallback, cutoff, or activation mismatch to the exact commitment.
Reject any genesis, chain, protocol, epoch, set, or parameters context mismatch.
Reject a different valid QC signer subset at the same block/view/height when its digest is not the one embedded in old_checkpoint_finality.
Reject either old-role or new-role signer power below its independently recomputed threshold.
Reject cross-role roots, signing contexts, message kinds, or signer-set substitution.
Reject signatures made under another nested domain and reject any claimed aggregate EpochHandoffProof domain.
Reject a malformed or cryptographically invalid proposer, QC, old-role, or new-role signature.
Fields 1..11 alone cannot authorize a version change or a present upgrade_plan_hash; field 12 is outside this kernel.

rust_shared_corpus_stages.rule: Exact decoders remain fail-closed. The one below-quorum certificate is rejected as insufficient_quorum at the committed old-role list-count offset before the B2-F composition verifier is callable; the other nine negatives exact-decode and reach the composition verifier.

honest_boundary: B2-F authenticates the exact old checkpoint/two-seal proof, commitment preimage, old/new set and parameter preimages, descriptor, independent handoff roles, and the field-1..11 composition relations only.
It returns no EpochAnchorQC, first-new-epoch proposal authority, new-epoch finality, trusted-checkpoint advancement, application execution claim, or weak-subjectivity renewal.
ProtocolUpgradePlan field 12, first_new_epoch_proposal field 13, and new_epoch_finality field 14 remain outside this tranche.

Snapshot/state membership, deterministic candidate construction, lowest fallback reason, PoP, governance provenance, runtime identity, checkpoint body execution, and persist-before-sign remain external.
EpochHandoffProof has no canonical aggregate CEV0 preimage, digest domain, or digest field.
